notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary Attribute Relevance Advisory rate reissue. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, rate object and attribute names, and distinct higher/lower update-rate designators. It verifies that adding a lower-rate active subscriber is silent, changes to the active maximum reissue Turn Updates On with the new designator, peer removal reissues the surviving rate, and the final unsubscribe delivers Turn Updates Off without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador update-rate lookup, publication, registration, subscription replacement, unsubscription, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador discovery and attribute-relevance callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador Attribute Relevance Advisory rate-reissue surface
